subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should OpenClaw support the Home-first Wear context workflow, including removal of the dedicated Agent and Session pages and capability-gated model controls during mixed Phone/Wear versions?
rationale: The patch is a well-proven feature, but choosing the durable Wear navigation model and acceptable paired-app upgrade behavior is a product contract rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Accept the Home-first contract
options.body: Merge the capability-gated implementation and make Home the supported location for Wear agent, session, and model selection.

options.title: Keep dedicated context pages
options.body: Request a narrower redesign that preserves Agent and Session pages while adding only the desired model-selection behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the Home-first contract
recommendation.body: Merge the capability-gated implementation and make Home the supported location for Wear agent, session, and model selection.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and the branch’s compatibility hardening commits indicate direct ownership of this Android/Wear direction.
